info.name: COMP3123 Assignment 1
info.description:
Employee management REST API (Node.js, Express, MongoDB).

Run the folders in order: Health -> Signup -> Login -> Employees (User A) -> Cross-user ownership.
Set {{baseUrl}} to http://localhost:3000 (local) or your Vercel URL.

Rate limits: signup and login allow AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX requests per window per IP (default 5).
The Signup folder alone sends 8 requests, so for a full collection run set AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=10 in .env and restart the server.
The limit is kept in memory: restart the server before running the collection again.
